question: A pyramid-shaped puzzle piece fits exactly into a square-based hole of depth 4 cm. If the base is 6 cm, what is the volume of the pyramid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Base Area** of square = side² = 6 × 6 = 36 cm².

**Volume** of **pyramid** = (1/3) × **Base Area** × **Height**.

Volume = (1/3) × 36 × 4 = 12 × 4 = 48 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Side** of **square base** (a) = 6 cm

**Depth** or **Vertical Height** (h) = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Volume** of **pyramid** = (1/3) × **Base Area** × **Height**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3683406a871fa6d6ecc42dd2ec8612034ad8326c2a3e1fefc257c29e104c7e8a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Base Area** = a² = 6 × 6 = 36 cm²

⇒ **Volume** = (1/3) × 36 × 4

⇒ **Volume** = 12 × 4

⇒ **Volume** = 48 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Property

A **pyramid** has exactly one-third the **volume** of a **prism** with the same **base area** and **height**.

Slant Height (l)

The **slant height** of a **square pyramid** is calculated using the Pythagorean theorem: l = √(h² + (a/2)²).

Surface Area

**Total Surface Area** = Base Area + (1/2) × Perimeter × Slant Height.</p
